input: Apply for a food handler's certification online

gold.taskTitle: Apply for Food Handler's Certification Online
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to complete and submit an online application to obtain a food handler's certification.

questions.title: Which state or country are you applying in?
questions.description: Certification requirements and approved providers vary significantly by location.

questions.title: Do you already have a specific certifying body in mind?
questions.description: Knowing whether the user has a preferred provider (e.g., ServSafe, StateFoodSafety, NRFSP) helps narrow down the exact application process.

questions.title: Is this required by a current or upcoming employer?
questions.description: If an employer is requiring this, they may have a specific approved program or deadline that must be followed.

questions.title: What is your deadline for completing the certification?
questions.description: Understanding the urgency helps prioritize steps and choose a program with the right turnaround time.

questions.title: Have you held a food handler's certification before?
questions.description: Prior certification history may affect whether this is a first-time application or a renewal, changing the process.

questions.title: Are you prepared to pay the application or exam fee?
questions.description: Most programs charge a fee; knowing if the user is ready to pay or needs a free option shapes which programs to recommend.

questions.title: Do you need the certification in a language other than English?
questions.description: Some providers offer multilingual exams; this affects which platform is the right fit for the user.
